meta.disclaimer: Not legal advice. These are the periods as each statute states them, read in the official code on the date shown. Tolling, discovery rules, notice-of-claim deadlines for claims against a government, minors' rules and other exceptions can shorten or lengthen the time to file, and statutes change. Check the statute and ask a lawyer licensed in the state before relying on a deadline.

changes.title: Version 2.0.0
changes.summary: Record-specific columns moved from limitations.csv to limitations-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; every figure is unchanged.

changes.title: Version 1.2.0
changes.summary: The files carry the 225 cells read in the official code or in a court opinion that quotes or applies the statute (193 primary, 32 secondary). No published value changed.

changes.title: Secondary cells from court opinions
changes.summary: 32 cells come from court opinions that quote or apply the statute, marked S (secondary), with the court, case, date and quote. New Hampshire product liability is now read in the official code (RSA 507-D:2). Primary cells are unchanged.

changes.title: First release
changes.summary: Statutes of limitations for personal injury, medical malpractice, wrongful death, product liability and property damage in every state and DC, each read in the official code with a verbatim quote.
